summary: KKR FS Income Trust Select filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026, reporting a Second Amendment to its Senior Secured Revolving Credit Agreement with ING Capital LLC as administrative agent. The amendment raises the applicable margin to 1.25% for ABR loans and 2.25% for term benchmark/RFR loans, removes the 0.10% US dollar credit adjustment spread, extends the commitment termination to September 30, 2030 and maturity to September 30, 2031, lifts the accordion to $800 million, and increases revolving commitments from $325 million to $375 million. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation.
